title: Force is computed on read; decay is measured on the activity clock
subject: graded-force
ratio:
Force is a value computed on read, never a stored field on any record: storing it would mutate
published records continuously as citations accumulate, violating the append-only immutability
discipline this registry enforces on published content, and computed-on-read also makes the
force formula itself amendable by ordinary code change without touching any record. Force is
computed over `status`, `authority_tier`, `published_by`, `published_at`, `relations[]`,
`operation.subtype`, and `cited_by` -- data publication and confirmation already write -- never
over `events.jsonl`, because the live event log is measured, at this epic's own audit, to carry
roughly 9,600 precedent-family events against a four-record registry, a pollution any
events-derived signal would inherit.

Decay -- the periodic pass flagging a never-cited tier 1-3 record as a reconsideration candidate
-- is likewise measured on this activity clock: the count of strictly-later-published records in
the same root, never wall-clock (which measures the burstiness of operator sessions, not neglect
by the polity) and never `events.jsonl` (corrupted by the same pollution). The calibrated
threshold is ten intervening publications: roughly one full epic-wave of registry activity
passing with zero citations, which is the earliest point at which "never recited" stops being
indistinguishable from "just published in this batch."

A decay flag changes nothing by itself -- no status change, no force drop -- until an agent
records a `context-change` or `error-in-pronouncement` valuation against the flagged record; the
machine flags, an agent decides, and the decision is itself a recorded, contestable act.
scope_conditions: any agent computing force or running the stale pass
revisit_trigger: Revisit if DECAY_N=10 or the C>=3 threshold is changed by a recorded amendment or a DEVIATION-noted code change
validity_conditions: stale computes the decay clock from the registry directory, never from events.jsonl
